environment.description: Same EC2 monolith (i-0a3f8b2c) with EFS at /opt/monolith. Lambda function URL endpoint exists at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. The function URL resource policy has a Condition block with StringEquals on lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM. The function URL was reconfigured with AuthType=AWS_IAM after initial deployment. Callers must present valid SigV4 signatures; unsigned requests receive 403 Forbidden from the Lambda service layer before invocation. The IAM policy attached to the only authorized principal (role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/deploy-pipeline-role) has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/DeployBoundary) that restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to source IP CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 via aws:SourceIp condition key. The role is assumable only by the CodePipeline service principal with an ExternalId condition.

config.network: function URL publicly resolvable but IAM auth enforced at service layer
